title: Additivity and essential surjectivity of the ordinary derived localization
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category, and use the ordinary unbounded derived category and universe convention of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Its canonical localization functor $Q:\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$ is additive: for parallel chain maps $f,g$ one has $Q(f+g)=Q(f)+Q(g)$. It is essentially surjective: for every $K\in D(\mathcal A)$ there are a cochain complex $C$ and an isomorphism $Q(C)\cong K$.
